Messages.Author: Frederic Genest
Messages.Body:
Helle all.

A few questions arose yesterday, for which we couldn't find or agree
on a definitive answer.

Magazine: the basic for our discussion was either or not the ammo
placed on the magazine is "permanent"...

1) When you put Magazine in play, you *must* put an ammo card on it at
that time, right?

2) Once you use that ammo, is it burned, leaving an empty magazine
that can later be replenished with another ammo card? The ammo is used
"as if played from your hand", so I argued it is burned, but I'm not
sure anymore, as I'm not sure the Magazine can be replenished later
(card text says to put an ammo card on the Magazine *when* it is
played - looks to me like a Rack that has lost its target due to a
(ex.:) Diablerie).

3) If you have a full Magazine, can you play another ammo card on this
gun while not using the Magazine? (I assume yes, but just checking).

Thanks!

FGe.

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
"Frederic Genest" <gen...@iname.com> wrote in message news:703899b7.03062...@posting.google.com...

> Magazine: the basic for our discussion was either or not the ammo
> placed on the magazine is "permanent"...
>
> 1) When you put Magazine in play, you *must* put an ammo card on it at
> that time, right?

Yes

> 2) Once you use that ammo, is it burned, leaving an empty magazine
> that can later be replenished with another ammo card? The ammo is used
> "as if played from your hand", so I argued it is burned, but I'm not
> sure anymore, as I'm not sure the Magazine can be replenished later
> (card text says to put an ammo card on the Magazine *when* it is
> played - looks to me like a Rack that has lost its target due to a
> (ex.:) Diablerie).

The ammo card entered play and there is no indication that it will be discarded.
The ammo is not USED as if played from your hand but the EFFECT of the
ammo card is used as if it were played from your hand. Ammo card not discarded.
Otherwise what is the point of the ammo card other than filling up a card slot?

> 3) If you have a full Magazine, can you play another ammo card on this
> gun while not using the Magazine? (I assume yes, but just checking).

No reason why not. "may use"

And I'm sure there will be someone more definitive along shortly to confirm
or rebut this. ;)

-JTP
